units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:11">Cant. R. to VIII, 11</cite> (v. <cite ref="E00597"><he>הָמוֹן</he></cite>, end) <he>שהמו אחריהם ה׳ דמלכוותא</he> the hosts of kingdoms were greedy for them (to have a foothold in their country).
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:52">Lam. R. to I, 17</cite> formerly I used to go up to the Temple <he>ה׳ ה׳ של חגיגה</he> in (singing) troops of pilgrimage.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 33:6">Lev. R. s. 33</cite> <he>הייתם נעשים הומניות הו׳ לע״ז</he> (corr. <he>המו׳</he>) ye used to form troops (noisy processions) for idolatry; v. <cite ref="D00448"><he>דִּיאוֹנִיסִין</he></cite>.
